verdict.rationale: Logseq has a dedicated Plugins system supporting marketplace and unpacked/sideloaded plugins, plus a community-maintained plugin API documentation site (plugins-doc.logseq.com) confirming an extension SDK exists with docs. However, the evidence shows this API doc site is community-driven rather than deep first-party developer docs with rich samples, and probes for machine-readable API specs (openapi/llms.txt) returned 404s, suggesting thinner formal API reference material. Missing for 10: first-party SDK reference with code samples, official API changelog/versioning docs, and independent developer testimonials building plugins.
